title: The needlepoint
logline: A needlepoint the shop framed in 1999 — a lighthouse, HOME on it — above a stove in a kitchen, grease on the glass. The house it's in: reserved. The page draws the grease.

panels.composition: A framed needlepoint of a lighthouse above a stove in a small kitchen, the glass filmed with grease, a kettle below, evening.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a framed needlepoint of a lighthouse hanging above a stove in a small kitchen with the glass filmed in grease and a kettle below, evening light, no words legible
image.notes: HOME on it: letter after, if at all.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
